title: Your own map
starter:
let rec my_map f l =
  match l with
  | [] -> []
  | x :: rest -> my_map f rest
hints: The starter walks the whole list but throws every element away. In the `x :: rest` case, what should the first element of the answer be?
The answer starts with `f x`, and the rest of it is `my_map f rest`. Join them with `::`.
`| x :: rest -> f x :: my_map f rest`

answer.code:
let rec my_map f l =
  match l with
  | [] -> []
  | x :: rest -> f x :: my_map f rest
answer.explain: The empty list maps to the empty list. For `x :: rest`, the result is `f x` stuck onto the front of the mapped rest: `f x :: my_map f rest`. The order stays the same because each `f x` goes in front of what comes after it.
